Pro hits the sweet spot between performance, price, and durability. With reinforced steel uprights, heavy-duty handrails, and an upgraded console, it delivers a pro-level experience to complete any pain cave.

FEATURES
SPECIFICATIONS
DIMENSIONS

Free Shipping

Free shipping to anywhere in the contiguous United States.

Comprehensive Warranty

The AssaultRunner Pro has you covered: 7-year frame, 3-year moving parts, 150k-mile belt.

THE ULTIMATE HOME GYM TREADMILL

Commercial durability meets home gym practicality. The AssaultRunner Pro is our most popular model — delivering pro-level performance with reinforced steel construction and an upgraded console.

TRUSTED BY THE BRANDS YOU LOVE

CURVED DECK

EARN EVERY STRIDE

Ditch the motor and face the brutal reality of your own effort. Pro’s curved design relies on you to power the belt and set the pace, enforcing a natural stride that mimics the mechanics of outdoor running.

•
Burns more calories and spikes heart rate faster than motorized treadmills
•
Reinforces strong posture, stride, and foot strike
•
No speed limit — you dictate the pace
•
Low-impact design minimizes risk of injury

PORTABLE & PLUG-FREE

FREEDOM TO GRIND

Whether it’s the garage, the gym floor, or the driveway, AssaultRunner Pro goes where the work is. This cordless and compact powerhouse is designed to be moved, used, and abused anywhere.

•
Compact design
•
No electricity required
•
Fit for any training environment
•
Simple assembly, low maintenance
•
Built-in transport wheels

SIMPLIFIED TECH

STAY LOCKED IN

If you want to watch a movie, stay on the sofa. This tread console is solely for work. We kept the interface simple with the essential stats you need to stay on top of your workout while you're gasping for air

Die Eleiko Adjustable Bench bietet eine solide Grundlage für eine große Auswahl an Freihantelübungen. Die Rückenlehne kann in sieben Positionen eingestellt werden, von -10 Grad Neigung bis zu einer 75-Grad-Neigung in Abstufungen von 15-Grad-Schritten. Das Sitzpolster bietet drei Positionen von flach bis zu einer Neigung von 30 Grad in Abstufungen von 15-Grad-Schritten.
